name: bookshelf
description: Three matching 5ft bookshelves in 18mm birch ply. Sides 63" x 11-3/4", shelves 30-3/4" x 11-3/4". Sides are grain-locked because their outer face shows; shelves are edge-banded so they may turn. Hand-checked layout on usable 2430 x 1210, four 300mm rows per sheet: six rows of [side 1600 + shelf 780] = 2383, six rows of [shelf x 3] = 2346. Twelve rows fill three sheets exactly, 4.9% waste at a perfect pack.
